name: @playarr-tv/web
description: Playarr Server standalone web app: Vite + React + TypeScript. Home/Library/Player/Settings routes, Admin's real request-management UI, and a versioned service-worker-driven OTA self-update flow (see src/lib/appUpdate.ts).

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-vidaa-store.mjs && node scripts/generate-build-manifest.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-cast-receiver.mjs
scripts.build:server: node scripts/generate-build-manifest.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --mode server && node scripts/rewrite-server-manifest.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @playarr-tv/web... run build && esbuild worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --external:cloudflare:sockets --outfile=dist-worker.mjs && node scripts/deploy-cloudflare-api.mjs
